Package kamkeel.npcdbc.api.effect

Interface IPlayerBonus

  • public interface IPlayerBonus
    Represents a named stat bonus that modifies a player's DBC attributes.

    Each bonus has a unique name and a type that determines how it stacks:

    • Type 0 - Percentage: Values are treated as percentage modifiers of the base attribute. For example, a strength value of 50 grants +50% of base strength. A value of -30 reduces strength by 30% of the base value. Multiple percentage bonuses are summed together (additive stacking), and the total is clamped so it cannot reduce an attribute by more than 100%.
    • Type 1 - Flat: Values are added directly to the attribute as flat amounts. Multiple flat bonuses are summed together.
    • Type 2 - Multiplicative: Values are treated as percentage modifiers that compound multiplicatively. Each bonus is converted to a factor (1 + value/100) and all factors are multiplied together. For example, two -50 bonuses result in 0.5 * 0.5 = 0.25 (75% total reduction), not 100%. Individual factors are clamped to >= 0 (cannot invert an attribute). Multiplicative bonuses are applied before Percentage and Flat bonuses.

    Order of application: Multiplicative (Type 2) → Percentage (Type 0) → Flat (Type 1). The final attribute value is floored to 1 to prevent division-by-zero.

    Bonuses are identified by name. Applying a bonus with the same name as an existing one will overwrite the previous bonus.

    See Also:
    IBonusHandler
